title: Power of Explanations: Towards automatic debiasing in hate speech detection
findings: The study found that hate speech detection models often learn biases, incorrectly associating religious identity terms (e.g., 'muslim', 'jewish', 'islam', 'allah') with hateful content. The proposed automatic misuse detector (MiD) successfully identified these biased religious terms without human supervision. The debiasing framework was able to suppress the feature attribution of these terms, reducing bias while maintaining competitive classification performance. The paper also found that correcting bias related to one religious term (e.g., 'muslims') could have indirect positive effects on semantically similar terms (e.g., 'islam', 'islamic').
